about: A company of AI agents as an org chart, each with a role, a budget and approvals, on the model router's key. AerieOS's guards do not reach its agents: its container and its own budgets do.

fields.label: Its companies and database
fields.help: its own folder, which holds its database, its companies and what its agents work on

fields.label: Its address
fields.help: the address people open it at, which its sign-in and invite links use

fields.label: Model router
fields.help: the router its agents call Claude through, with a key of the container's own; the router needs an Anthropic key

fields.label: Session secret
fields.help: signs its sign-ins; made for it when left empty

fields.label: Agent secret
fields.help: signs the tokens its agents call it with; made for it when left empty

fields.label: Approval secret
fields.help: signs approvals of the tools that wait for one; made for it when left empty

label: Paperclip
name: paperclip
